commit 6f12fc494d749369c98215c294f44c3c716ae7e3
Author:     Eleanor Dicharry <edicharry@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Nov 13 12:55:21 2025 +1300
Commit:     Eleanor Dicharry <edicharry@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Nov 13 12:55:21 2025 +1300

    Bug 1999665 - Remove unneeded lmdb-rkv-sys dependency. r=darktrojan
    
    
    Firefox's rkv library used to depend on lmdb, but it appears
    that is no longer so and the dependency was here to work around
    https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/58393
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D272341

diff --git a/rust/Cargo.lock b/rust/Cargo.lock
index 1f7abc483c8..f63f7c0a0b2 100644
--- a/rust/Cargo.lock
+++ b/rust/Cargo.lock
@@ -2456,7 +2456,6 @@ dependencies = [
  "graph_xpcom",
  "kvstore-gtest",
  "l10nregistry-ffi-gtest",
- "lmdb-rkv-sys",
  "moz_task-gtest",
  "mozglue-static",
  "mozilla-central-workspace-hack",
@@ -3514,17 +3513,6 @@ version = "0.4.1"
 source = "registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"
 checksum = "b4ce301924b7887e9d637144fdade93f9dfff9b60981d4ac161db09720d39aa5"
 
-[[package]]
-name = "lmdb-rkv-sys"
-version = "0.11.2"
-source = "registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"
-checksum = "61b9ce6b3be08acefa3003c57b7565377432a89ec24476bbe72e11d101f852fe"
-dependencies = [
- "cc",
- "libc",
- "pkg-config",
-]
-
 [[package]]
 name = "locale_service_glue"
 version = "0.1.0"
diff --git a/rust/gtest/Cargo.toml b/rust/gtest/Cargo.toml
index cef557b2139..508daf1b2d8 100644
--- a/rust/gtest/Cargo.toml
+++ b/rust/gtest/Cargo.toml
@@ -26,7 +26,6 @@ kvstore-gtest = { path = "../../../toolkit/components/kvstore/test/gtest" }
 # Workarounds for https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/58393
 mozglue-static = { path = "../../../mozglue/static/rust" }
 swgl = { path = "../../../gfx/wr/swgl" }
-lmdb-rkv-sys = "0.11"
 
 [lib]
 path = "lib.rs"
